# Orch v0.1.1

Starting work now follows the access people were given: Use of an environment is enough to start a thread in it,
and starting threads or making topics can be given on their own.

## Update

No manual database or configuration changes are needed. Download the release files for your architecture and run
`./update.sh v0.1.1 --from <directory with the release files>` in the deployment directory; `deploy/README.md`
describes updates and rollback.

## Changes

- **Use of an environment starts threads.** Whoever may use an environment can start a thread in it; Manage is
  for setting the environment up and deciding who uses it.
- **Start threads and Create topics** can be given alone, on a topic and on a project. The middle level of an
  organization, project and topic is now called **Contribute** and includes both; Interact keeps its meaning for
  threads and chats, where it means talking to the agent and people.
- **The environment picker** lists what you can use first. Environments you can see but not use follow under
  **Ask for access**; picking one opens the access request for its Use.
- **The new-thread form** says whether the Directory you type exists in the environment or will be created.
- Default and Developer tools are editable Dockerfile templates. Each host builds its image on first use;
  unchanged older built-in templates switch to the Dockerfiles automatically.
- Release packaging fetches every crate it lists in the third-party notices; CI checks formatting once on Linux and
  runs on branch pushes only.
